description: The one tool that answers 'I earn from several platforms, in several currencies — how much do I actually end up with in my own currency?' Give it a list of platform earnings (each with its own currency and platform fee %), plus your country and target currency, and it converts and combines them all through whichever international-account provider (Wise, Payoneer, Airwallex, etc.) nets you the most money — using live exchange rates, not estimates. This aggregation-across-platforms capability is not something other free take-home-pay calculators do; most only handle one platform and one currency at a time. Mirrors platformincome.com/currency-takehome.html exactly. Call list_currency_takehome_countries first if you don't know a country's 2-letter code.

country.description: 2-letter country code you'll receive the money in, e.g. 'US', 'NG', 'IN'. Call list_currency_takehome_countries for the full list.

platforms.description: One entry per platform/income source you want combined into a single total.

amount.description: Gross earnings from this platform, in its own currency.

currency.description: 3-letter currency code this platform paid out in, e.g. 'USD', 'EUR'.

label.description: Optional display name for this row, e.g. 'YouTube', 'Direct Client A'.

platformFeePercent.description: This platform's own fee %, deducted before conversion. Use 0 for a direct client with no platform cut. Check list_take_home_platforms for typical fee %s by platform.

targetCurrency.description: 3-letter currency code to convert everything into, e.g. 'USD', 'NGN', 'EUR'.

name: currency_takehome_calculator
title: Combined Multi-Platform / Multi-Currency Take-Home Calculator
